_comment: Few-shot examples show behavior and format only; no real prices, IDs, or answer tables.

examples.question: Mua <qty> <product> dung ma <coupon> giao <city>, tong cong?
examples.ideal_answer: Use check_stock, get_discount, calc_shipping. If orderable, compute exactly and end: Tong cong: <integer> VND

examples.question: Mua <qty> <unknown_or_out_of_stock_product> giao <city>, tong cong?
examples.ideal_answer: Refuse briefly because the product cannot be ordered. Do not include any Tong cong line.
